Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Sri Lanka players make their way out to the middle, followed by Jason Roy and Jos Buttler. Dushmantha Chameera will start with the ball.

Right then! England need 130 runs to win! They certainly have the batting power to chase this down and take a 1-0 lead in the series. Sri Lanka would need to bowl extremely well if they want to make a match of this. Do join us in a while for the run chase.

Chris Woakes is there for a chat, he says it's great to back out on the pitch after a while. Adds it's a good performance from the team. Says the wicket is a bit pacy early up but at the end, the slower balls worked it out. Tells that the Indian T20 League is a high-class tournament and it is great to be back in the England team as well.

England's bowling was really good! They were at the top of their game from the beginning and it has been a terrific effort. Chris Woakes did a good job on his return while Mark Wood bowled with pace. Chris Jordan and Adil Rashid were the stars though as they kept it tight and even chipped in with wickets. Liam Livingstone was the other one to get a wicket. Overall, it was a super bowling performance and they will back themselves to chase this down.

Sri Lanka were not off to a great start as they lost Avishka Fernando pretty quickly. Danushka Gunathilaka looked good but threw his wicket away and then they kept on losing wickets with no one really stepping up for the Island Nation. They looked at getting to around 100-110 at one stage but Dasun Shanaka played a really crucial innings and got them to 129 which is something they can bowl at, despite the batting line-up of England.

End of a fabulous bowling performance from England! They have restricted Sri Lanka to just 129 on the board and they will be very happy with the effort by their bowlers. Sri Lanka will be disappointed with the effort as they threw away their wickets and if not for Dasun Shanaka, they would have ended with an even low score.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A good innings from Dasun Shanaka comes to an end! Slower ball outside off, Shanaka looks to swing it away but gets a top edge and goes to the right of the keeper. Buttler moves to that side and takes a simple catch. SRI LANKA END ON 129 FOR 7.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Low full toss outside off, Shanaka plays it to deep point for a couple. Dasun Shanaka reaches his fifty as well. He has played well here and has given the bowlers something to bowl at.
Lands safely! Fullish ball outside off, Shanaka looks to heave it away but it takes the top edge and goes towards long on. It lands safely and two taken.
SIX! Shanaka is playing a very handy innings! Short ball on middle, Shanaka pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Short ball around middle, Shanaka looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and goes over short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Good length ball around off, Shanaka looks to paddle sweep but gets it off the bottom edge and it goes to the keeper.
Sam Curran will bowl the final over.
Short ball on middle, Shanaka looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and it lands safely in front of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
SIX! Shanaka has sure got enough of that! Full on middle and leg, Shanaka clears his front leg and then smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.

FOUR! Sri Lanka needed this! Good length ball on the pads, Shanaka heaves it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. There are 4 fielders in the deep on the leg side, still Shanaka manages to find the gap.
PLAY AND A MISS! Slower ball outside off, Shanaka looks to cut but misses.
Full and on the pads, whipped to deep square leg for just a single.
Full on the pads, Shanaka heaves it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, Dasun tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. End of a wonderful spell from Adil Rashid.
Flatter outside off, Shanaka pushes it to point.
Floated on the pads, Udana sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball on the pads, Udana looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. Sri Lanka need to get a move-on.
Loopy ball on middle, Shanaka sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on off, Udana plays it to cover-point for a single.
Full on middle, Shanaka drives it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Udana pushes it to cover for a single. 100 up for Sri Lanka.
Full on middle, Shanaka flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower short ball on middle, Shanaka looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
Low full toss outside off, Shanaka drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Isuru Udana is getting his arm guard changed.
Good length ball on middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Chris Jordan is back into the attack. 2-0-13-1 are his figures so far.
Loopy ball, on off. Shanaka pushes it to covers. Three runs and a wicket from Adil Rashid's over.
Fullish length, on middle. Isuru Udana pushes it to long on for a single. He is off the mark straightaway.
Isuru Udana is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! 6 down now Sri Lanka! Tossed up delivery, on middle. Wanindu Hasaranga shimmies down and looks to heave it on the leg side, but gets the inner half of the bat, straight in the hands of Chris Jordan at long on. He won't drop those.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it back to bowler.
On middle. This is nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga dances down and drives it to covers for a single.
10 coming off this over! A back of a length ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga hops and punches it to the deep point region for a single.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on a length and on off. Shanaka tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka looks to drive but gets inner half of the bat, back to the bowler
A length ball, on off. Shanaka pushes it to the point fielder.
FOUR! Same length, Same result! Another back of a length ball, wide of outside off. Shanaka cuts it towards the third man fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Welcome Boundary! A back of a length ball, wide of outside off. Shanaka cuts it to third man for four. The fielder is too wide on the ropes.
Mark Wood will finish his spell.
Flatter on off, Hasaranga pushes it to cover.
Tossed up outside off, Hasaranga dances down the track and then drives it through the cover region for a couple.
On off, Shanaka works it down to long on for a single.
Floated on off, Hasaranga defends it to cover for a single.
Short ball on middle, Shanaka pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chris Jordan will not drop such dollies! Kusal Perera is done by the googly. Adil Rashid bowls it on middle, Perera dances down the track and looks to go over long off but does not time it well. It goes towards long off where Chris Jordan takes it easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Jason Roy has doen really well here! Short ball on middle, Shanaka pulls it to deep square leg. Roy comes across and slides to save it. Two taken.
Short ball around middle, Shanaka looks to pull but misses.
Good length ball around off, Shanaka dances down the track and looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short ball outside off, Shanaka sways away from it.
Short ball on middle, Shanaka pulls it to deep square leg where the fielder fumbles and allows a couple of runs
Full on middle, Perera drives it past the bowler. Bairstow comes across from long on and does well to parry it to Jordan. Keeps it down to just a single.
Chris Woakes is back on.
Loopy ball, on middle. Dasun Shanaka steps down and wrists it wide of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Another tossed up delivery, on middle. Perera flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fraction short, on middle. Shanaka pulls it to square leg for a single.
Darts this on the pads. Shanaka sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
On middle. Blocked out on the deck.
Tossed up, on leg pole. Kusal Perera dances down and pushes it to covers for a single.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
Another short ball, on middle. Pulled to square leg for a single.
On middle. This is worked on the on side of a single.
LEG BYE! A short of a length ball, on middle. Kusal Perera mises his pull, gets hit on the chest area. The ball rolls over to the off side and a single is taken.
Wide! Length ball, drifting down the leg side. Wide called.
A length ball, on middle. This is pushed on the off side for a single.
Another short ball, on middle. Kusal Perera pulls it along the ground to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! In the air and it goes over the fielder! A back of a length ball, on middle. Perera pulls it but not of the middle of the bat towards fine leg, where Adil Rashid sees the ball sail over him for a six.
On off, Shanaka defends it to cover.
Full on middle, Perera reverse sweeps it to short third man for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Shanaka punches it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, Perera sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Shanaka works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Perera works it to the leg side for a single.
Another play and a miss! Brilliant over from Mark Wood! Good length ball outside off, Shanaka misses his defense. Just 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
A slip and a gully now.
BEATEN! This is top bowling from Mark Wood! Good length ball outside off, Shanaka pokes at it but fails to get any bat on it again.
PLAY AND A MISS! Too quick from Wood! Good length ball outside off, Shanaka looks to defend but misses.
Dasun Shanaka is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AT THIRD MAN! Everything that Morgan is doing is working! He brought in Livingstone and that worked and now brought back Mark wood, another wicket falls. Sri Lanka sink further. Short ball outside off, de Silva looks to play the upper cut but hits it straight to third man where Adil Rashid takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! Almost another one! Good length ball outside off, de Silva looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge and it goes to the keeper.
Full and outside off, de Silva drives it through the cover region for a couple.
Mark Wood is back on. Gave away 10 runs in his first over.
On middle. Dhananjaya de Silva flicks it to square leg and gets off the mark straightaway with a single. 50 up for Sri Lanka as well.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! All reds it is! Fullish length delivery, on middle. Mendis goes for the paddle sweep but misses, gets hit on the pads. England appeal for LBW and the umpire takes no time to raise his finger. Kusal Mendis takes a review. Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Kusal Mendis is a goner.
Review time! Kusal Mendis has been given out LBW. He takes the review. There is nothing on Ultra Edge. The Ball Tracker shows all reds and Mendis has to go. Takes the review along with him.
LEG BYE! Sees Perera dancing down the track, Liam Livingstone bowls a flatter, quicker delivery, outside off. Perera misses his flick and a leg bye is taken.
Darted on the pads. Mendis flicks it to square leg for a single.
Leg spinner, this time on middle. Mendis drags it wide of mid-wicket for couple of runs.
Starts with a tossed up delivery, on middle. This is pushed back to bowler.
Liam Livingstone is into the attack.
Comes over the wicket and bowls a full length delivery on middle. Mendis pushes it to long on for a single.
Full ball, on middle. Perera flicks it in front of square leg for one.
Good length ball, on off. Mendis opens his bat face and guides this one to third man for a single.
Two taken! A length delivery, on the pads. Mendis flicks it between square leg and mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Another good length delivery, outside off. Kusal Perera pushes it to covers for a single.
Loose Shot! A length delivery, outside off. Perera drags his shot straight to mid-wicket on a bounce.
Fullish ball on the pads, Perera flicks it to deep square leg for a single. End of the Powerplay. Sri Lanka are 39 for 2.
Good length ball on off, Perera heaves it to the deep square leg region for two.
On middle, nudges to the leg side for a single.
On a length on middle, Mendis tucks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Mendis looks to defend but misses.
Shortish ball on off, Perera pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Perera looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Good length ball on the pads, Perera nudges it to short fine leg and crosses over for a single.
Good length ball on the pads, Mendis works it to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish ball on off, Mendis defends it to point.
Kusal Mendis is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Was this shot necessary? Gunathilaka got a boundary off the last ball but has thrown it away here. Good length ball around middle, Gunathilaka looks to paddle it over the keeper but it goes off the gloves and towards Buttler who takes one of the easiest catches, he will ever take.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Clever from Gunathilaka! Good length ball outside off, Guathilaka opens the face of the bat and guides it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Perera pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Chris Jordan is into the attack.

FOUR! Back-to-Back Boundaries! Comes round the wicket and bowls a length ball, on off. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room on off side and slaps it over covers for a boundary. The fielder has a chase but the ball wins the race.
FOUR! Lovely Shot! A length ball, on middle. Gunalthilaka drives it past the bowler and into the fence at long off.
Short ball, on middle. Kusal Perera pulls it to square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, on the pads. Perera flicks it straight to short fine leg.
Good length ball, on the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka gets underneath and pushes it to mid on.
Mark Wood is into the attack.
Another fullish delivery, on middle. Perera flicks it on the leg side and takes a couple of runs to end the over.
FOUR! Just over the fielder. A length ball, on middle. Perera flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Appeal but turned down! A length ball, on middle, nips back in a bit. Perera looks to flick but misses.
Full ball, on the pads. Danushka Gunathilaka flicks it to mid-wicket. Sam Curran at mid-wicket has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Another good length delivery, removes the pace. Gunathilaka goes for the paddle sweep but doesn't connect any bat on it.
Full delivery, outside off. Gunathilaka drives it but straight to the mid off fielder.
On a length on middle, Gunathilaka works it to the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Very full down the leg side, Gunathilaka sets himself up to play the paddle sweep but misses. To England's dismay, the umpire signals it a wide.
Good length ball outside off, Gunathilaka pushes it to deep cover and takes a couple.
Good length ball on off, Perera defends it to cover-point and gets off the mark with a single.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Perera looks to flick but misses. Wided. There is an appeal for a caught behind but the umpire shows no interest.
Kusal Perera is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AT MID OFF! Chris Jordan is safe as houses as Fernando finds him perfectly. Full ball on off, Fernando looks to go over mid off but it is not timed well and does not have the elevation. It goes to Chris Jordan at mid off who takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, Fernando pushes it to cover.
Yorker on the the pads, Gunathilaka works it to the leg side for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Sam Curran it is.
Excellent start from Woakes! Good length ball on middle, Fernando defends it back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Fernando defends it back to the bowler. This is a good start from Woakes.
Full on off, Danushka drives it to mid off and gets off the mark with a single.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Gunathilaka looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Full ball on off, Gunathilaka dances down the track and drives but finds the fielder at cover.
Good length ball on middle, Gunathilaka gets behind the line of the delivery and then defends it back to the bowler.
Woakes starts with a full one on middle and leg, Gunathilaka works it to mid on.
We are all set to start! England players make their way out in the middle, followed by the Sri Lanka openers - Danushka Gunathilaka and Avishka Fernando. Chris Woakes to begin the proceedings.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Avishka Fernando, Kusal Perera (C & WK), Kusal Mendis, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Akila Dananjaya, Dushmantha Chameera, Nuwan Pradeep.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Eoin Morgan (C), Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, Chris Jordan, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood.
TOSS - Time for the coin toss. The coin goes up, Sri Lanka have won the toss and they elect to bat first.

Hello and a welcome to the first T20I between England and Sri Lanka. Two contrasting teams are going up against each other with one a very strong side and the other, a relatively inexperienced one. England have got their main stars back in the form of Buttler, Ali, Woakes, Morgan Bairstow while Sri Lanka would look to cause an upset. Who will come out on top?
